description: Create a draft proposal in the user's TempoRevenue account from a short description of the client's request: client name, scope, timeline and budget. If the request states a price, it is used as the total; otherwise the price is calculated from the user's own rates. Returns a link to review and send. Uses one proposal from the user's allowance.

deal_description.description: Brief description of the client's request. Do not send the full chat history.

language.description: Language of the proposal. If omitted, it follows the language of the description.

name: create_proposal
title: Create proposal
